 and

 Vs.
 1.The District Revenue Officer cum
 Additional District Magistrate,

 2.The Food Safety Officer,
 Vickramasingapuram (Town),
 Ambasamuthiram Taluk,
 Tirunelveli District. ...  Re  Prayer: Writ petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution o  to issue a Writ of Certiorari, calling for the records of the first  herein in Na.Ka.No.Na2/11761/2015 dated --.04.2017 signed on  07.04.2017 and quash the impugned order imposing a penalty of  Rs.50,000/- as against the petitioner. 
 For Petitioner : Mr.C.Suresh Kannan  For Respondents : Mr.R.Suresh Kumar  Additional Government Pleader https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis  1/5  W.P(
 ORDER M.Mathiyalagan vs The District Revenue Officer Cum on 3 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142040687/
1 In view of the constitution of the Tribunal, the learned counsel for the petitioner on instructions seeks permission of this Court to withdraw the Writ Petition, with liberty to approach the concerned Tribunal. 
2. In view of the statement made, the Writ Petition is dismissed as withdrawn, with liberty granted to the petitioner to approach the Tribunal. It is made clear that when the petitioner approaches the Tribunal, the period during which this Writ Petition was pending shall be excluded for the purpose of calculating the period of limitation. No costs. 
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
